guild.name: AI Guild
guild.tagline: Your AI companions and tools, in one place.
guild.description: A private, game-style catalog of your AI environment.

theme.font: Inter, "Hiragino Sans", "Noto Sans JP", system-ui, sans-serif

art.style: premium polished soft 3D toy-like illustration, white backdrop, lavender and deep-purple accents, coral only as a tiny detail
art.characterConcept: cute animal companions, each holding one tool that shows their job
subjects: red panda engineer with a tiny wrench
penguin operator with a signal flag
fox strategist with a chess token
capybara mentor with a tea cup
deer navigator with a star chart
art.toolStyle: premium polished soft 3D object render, pure white backdrop, white, lavender and deep-purple palette; a single practical object, no animals, no faces, no text
art.constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no real people, no private data
